title: Weekly average daily food waste, baseline vs intervention (Figure 1)
note: Slide 4 gives only the single overall before/after average (42.8kg to 31.9kg, 25%); the week-by-week trend and the six individual weekly values from the chart are not shown anywhere in the deck.
description: A bar chart titled 'Figure 1. Weekly average daily food waste, baseline vs intervention'. Six bars, one per week, in kilograms of average daily food waste. Baseline (Week 1-3, grey): 42.5, 44.1, 41.8 kg. Intervention (Week 4-6, orange): 35.6, 31.2, 29.0 kg, separated by a dashed vertical line. Shows a clear downward trend across the three intervention weeks, not just a flat before/after split.
